findings.summary: `--bg-base` token value mismatch — globals.css defines `--bg-base: #020b18` but the design spec requires `#0B1120`. The entire app background is darker than intended. Update to `#0B1120`.

StatCard and ChartCard bind to `var(--bg-card)` (`#0a1628`) instead of the new `var(--bg-panel)` (`#151F32`). The `--bg-panel` token exists but is only consumed by `/home`. Replace `var(--bg-card)` with `var(--bg-panel)` in StatCard.tsx and ChartCard.tsx, or alias the tokens.

Two hard-coded hex literals remain in `/home/page.tsx`: primary NavButton uses `color: "#0B1120"` and ExperimentCard receives `accentColor="#8b5cf6"`. Replace with `var(--bg-base)` and the pre-existing `--accent-violet` token respectively.
